title: The Birthday Party
summary: A family prepares a birthday party with simple past-tense actions.

paragraphs.pt: No sábado, a família de Sofia preparou uma festa surpresa para o aniversário dela. A mãe fez um bolo de chocolate, o pai comprou refrigerante, e o irmão pendurou balões coloridos na sala.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday, Sofia's family prepared a surprise party for her birthday. Her mother made a chocolate cake, her father bought soda, and her brother hung colorful balloons in the living room.

paragraphs.pt: Sofia chegou às quatro horas e encontrou todos os amigos cantando parabéns. Ela ficou emocionada, porque achou que ninguém tinha lembrado da data. Depois, abriu os presentes e agradeceu a cada pessoa.
paragraphs.en: Sofia arrived at four o'clock and found all her friends singing happy birthday. She was moved because she thought no one had remembered the date. Then she opened the gifts and thanked each person.

paragraphs.pt: À noite, a família limpou a casa, mas guardou um pedaço de bolo na geladeira. Sofia disse que aquele foi o melhor aniversário dos últimos anos.
paragraphs.en: At night, the family cleaned the house, but saved a piece of cake in the refrigerator. Sofia said that it was the best birthday of recent years.

comprehension.question: What kind of party did Sofia's family prepare?
Where did the family keep a piece of cake?
